description: This file defines a Java annotation interface `InjectView`, used to mark fields in Android Activities as injectable views, primarily for dependency injection purposes. It is part of a package related to view injection/injection utilities in an Android voicemail sample project.

classes.name: InjectView
classes.description: A Java annotation interface used to specify that a field should be injected with a View resource by an injector mechanism.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Annotation element that specifies the resource id of the View to inject into the annotated field.
